title: Sloth reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tree branch -->
  <rect x='5' y='78' width='90' height='10' rx='5' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <rect x='5' y='78' width='90' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0714F'/>
  
  <!-- Sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  
  <!-- Left arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#A0825E' transform='rotate(20 30 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='62' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#C4A87E' transform='rotate(20 30 62)'/>
  
  <!-- Right arm holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#A0825E' transform='rotate(-20 70 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='5' ry='10' fill='#C4A87E' transform='rotate(-20 70 62)'/>
  
  <!-- Book left page -->
  <rect x='28' y='55' width='22' height='18' rx='2' fill='#F5F5DC'/>
  <rect x='30' y='57' width='18' height='3' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='17' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  
  <!-- Book right page -->
  <rect x='50' y='55' width='22' height='18' rx='2' fill='#FFFDE8'/>
  <rect x='52' y='57' width='18' height='3' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  <rect x='52' y='62' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  <rect x='52' y='66' width='17' height='2' rx='1' fill='#D4C89A'/>
  
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x='49' y='54' width='2' height='20' rx='1' fill='#B8860B'/>
  
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <rect x='26' y='53' width='2' height='22' rx='1' fill='#8B0000'/>
  <rect x='72' y='53' width='2' height='22' rx='1' fill='#8B0000'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  
  <!-- Face mask (lighter area) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#D4C4A0'/>
  
  <!-- Eye patches (dark, but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5A4A3A'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#5A4A3A'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A1A0A'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='44' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2A1A0A'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='43' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='43' rx='1.2' ry='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 53 Q50 57 55 53' stroke='#6B4B2A' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='4' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='4' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  
  <!-- Legs hanging down -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#A0825E'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#C4A87E'/>
  
  <!-- Toes/claws -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='89' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='89' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='89' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='90' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='89' r='1.5' fill='#8B6B4A'/>
  
  <!-- Top of head fur tuft -->
  <path d='M44 30 Q47 25 50 28 Q53 24 56 30' fill='#A0825E' stroke='#8B6B4A' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Chevron pattern on chest -->
  <path d='M40 60 L50 66 L60 60' stroke='#A0825E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
